summary: This bill reauthorizes a grant program aimed at addressing dental workforce shortages by allocating $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes a grant program to address dental workforce needs, which directly impacts access to and quality of healthcare services, specifically dental care. By funding programs that increase the dental workforce, it supports a more publicly accessible healthcare system.

The bill reauthorizes and modestly increases annual appropriations ($15M for five years) for a dental workforce grant program, adding new federal spending that would increase the deficit absent offsets.

The entire bill consists of reauthorizing a Public Health Service Act grant program that uses federal funds to expand the dental workforce, constituting direct government intervention to improve healthcare access and affordability.
